sloka: भूतग्रामाश्च बहवो मांसभक्षाः सुदारुणाः ।गन्धर्वपुत्रमांसानि भोक्तुकामाः सहस्रशः ।। ७.१००.२३ ॥
transliteration: bhūtagrāmāśca bahavo māṁsabhakṣāḥ sudāruṇāḥ ।gandharvaputramāṁsāni bhoktukāmāḥ sahasraśaḥ ।। 7.100.23 ॥

translations.english: And many thousands of very terrible flesh-eating spirits, desirous of consuming the flesh of the Gandharva princes, also followed.
